name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova tooltip, fixed: 24px tall with a 6px radius and no arrow, its words 11px (text-2xs), a small label as agentui's floating things are. On its inverted surface, secondary text (text-muted-foreground, text-subtle-foreground: a FieldDescription's) is the background's colour faded, legible. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). It pops in and out by the theme's motion-pop (in at 150ms on --ease-enter, out at 100ms on --ease-exit), not shadcn's 100ms on `ease`.
